overview_description.description: Makwa is a mobile app providing doorstep dry cleaning and laundry pick-up and delivery services. Customers use the app to schedule pickup and delivery time slots, give special washing/ironing instructions, track orders, review order history, rate the service, and pay online. Makwa partners with high-quality vendors in the areas in which it operates who clean customers’ clothes, while following Makwa’s manual and meeting its stringent specs.

product.name: Laundry Marketplace App
product.description: A mobile application that connects users with multiple laundry service vendors for scheduling pickup and delivery of laundry items.

product.name: Clean & Iron Service
product.description: A service that includes dry cleaning, washing, hand washing, pressing, and packaging of clothes according to label instructions and user preferences.

product.name: Iron Service
product.description: A service that removes wrinkles from clothes by steam ironing at temperatures between 180-220°C, followed by packaging per customer preferences.

product.name: Vendor Partnership Program
product.description: A program that allows laundry businesses to join Makwa's online marketplace to offer their services and manage orders through Makwa's platform.
